item.title: Fabio Wardley vs. Daniel Dubois Livestream: How to Watch the Pay-Per-View Boxing Event Online
item.description:
[INTRO MUSIC FADES OUT]
Host: Welcome to the show, boxing fans. This Saturday, May 9, two British heavyweights are set to clash in a highly anticipated championship match. Fabio Wardley, the current WBO Interim World Heavyweight champion, will defend his title against Daniel Dubois. The 12-round bout will take place at the Co-op Live Arena in Manchester, England.
[SHORT MUSIC TRANSITION]
Host: If you want to catch the action live, you can stream the event on DAZN, starting at 1 p.m. ET or 10 a.m. PT. The main event is expected to kick off around 6 p.m. ET or 3 p.m. PT. You can purchase the pay-per-view event for $59.99, or sign up for DAZN's "Ultimate Tier" for $49.99 per month with an annual plan, which includes access to 12 PPV events and over 100 live fights per year.
[SHORT MUSIC TRANSITION]
Host: The main card is stacked with exciting matchups, including Jack Rafferty vs. Ekow Essuman, Bradley Rea vs. Liam Cameron, and David Morrell vs. Zak Chelli. And, of course, the highlight of the evening: Fabio Wardley vs. Daniel Dubois for the WBO Interim World Heavyweight title.
[SHORT MUSIC TRANSITION]
Host: As for the boxers' walkout music, while it hasn't been officially announced, Wardley typically walks out to "Can't Be Touched" by Roy Jones Jr., while Dubois prefers "I Don't Want to Be a General" by Dennis Brown. We'll have to wait and see if they stick to their usual tunes.
[OUTRO MUSIC FADES IN]
Host: That's all for now. Don't miss the Fabio Wardley vs. Daniel Dubois PPV event, live on DAZN, this Saturday, May 9. Thanks for tuning in, and we'll catch you in the next one.
